description.value: A family-run farm market operating since the early 1980s on King Road in Abbotsford, rooted in a raspberry and chicken farm started by the Neufeld family in 1966. The market specializes in free-run, hormone-free chicken along with turkey, beef, pork, seafood, produce, berries, and local specialty items. They also operate The Berry Barn for seasonal produce and soft ice cream, and run a well-known community fundraising program.
